semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Daitron provides components and systems that support semiconductor manufacturing environments, particularly in power supply and connectivity solutions.
summary: Daitron specializes in ultra-low noise switching power supplies, hermetic connectors, and environmental sensors tailored for cleanroom applications. Their products are designed to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor manufacturing, ensuring reliable performance in challenging environments.
capabilities: Hermetic connectors with metal and glass sealing technology
